what: equivalence and timing of the optimized Classic solver against reference.py, the frozen fe25d98 baseline. Regenerated deliberately, not on every test run, because the reference is the slow implementation by construction.

stacked_main_slate.spec: QB2 RB5 WR8 TE3 DST1 per team

group_minimum_4_teams.spec: QB2 RB4 WR6 TE3 DST1 per team
group_minimum_4_teams.why: the stacked decomposition multiplies a leaf-only group test across every (QB, mate-count, bring-back-count, distribution) cell. Before the group-reachability prune this case took 36.62s here against the reference 0.07s -- a 500x REGRESSION that every correctness test passed, because the answer was right and only the time was wrong.

exactness: each lineup in each portfolio matched the reference on objective AND on player set, compared as a sorted id set in portfolio order. The bounds are admissible -- value and salary bounds can only over-estimate a completion, and group reachability can only over-estimate what a completion can contain -- so no prune can discard a lineup better than the incumbent.
target: owner target was 20 lineups on a realistic main-slate pool, exact and deterministic, preferably under 30s
